logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GSOC で SOC 運用の基礎を固めた後、SIEM/検知エンジニアリング深度として GCDA に進むのが SANS のラダー。

plus.note: SIEM/検知エンジニアリング向け資格は希少で、SANS SEC555 系の権威性が高い。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 1, professional: 2. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Detection-engineering coverage, accreditation and recorded SANS support justify professional detection responsibility despite the two-year profile; the open-book assessment limits direct evidence of operational implementation.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accredited detection-engineering coverage has direct value for professional SIEM and detection work in an MSSP. The two-year profile and lack of a recorded practical component temper the signal, and the expensive bundle is not itself evidence of seniority.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded SIEM and detection-engineering focus is operationally useful, but the profile is two years and no practical assessment is specified. I therefore assess associate knowledge rather than infer professional detection delivery from accreditation.
